# Ariel Anders, PhD — AI & Robotics Engineering Portfolio

> Ariel Anders, PhD (MIT CSAIL) is a Senior Roboticist, AI Consulting Engineer, and Senior Software Engineer based in San Francisco, CA.

## Core Expertise
- **Robotics Software Engineering**: Motion planning under uncertainty, conformant belief-state manipulation, autonomous mobile robots, ROS 2, C++, Python.
- **Agentic DevAI & Infrastructure**: Stateful multi-agent developer workflows, LLM orchestration, automated code auditing guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, CI/CD automation.
- **Autonomous Systems Industry Experience**: Waymo (Senior SWE, Motion Planning), Robust.AI (First Roboticist & Behavior Lead, Indoor Navigation), Civ Robotics (Forklift Navigation & Localization), MIT CSAIL (PhD Research).

## Featured Open-Source Projects & Deep-Dives
- **GitOps PR Reviewer**: Multi-agent AI pull request reviewer with automated static analysis and code auditing guardrails.
- **VersionTruth**: Automated dependency synchronization and security audit validation tool for node and python ecosystems.
- **Deployment Impact Analyzer**: Multi-model DOM & visual diff engine for detecting frontend regressions in PRs.
- **Conformant Belief-State Manipulation**: PhD thesis research on learning physics-based models for planning under actuation/sensing uncertainty.
